name: Survey tile in Cetus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cetus, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 0.99 to 4.06 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
